g.text: Ranked by effect on what gets baked, with a suggested fix.

rect.data-description: ISSUE. Up to about 22% too few bags on 11 doughs. Fix: SUMIFS only the level-1 lines (FormatLevel = 1), or sum raw materials only. Section 1.

rect.data-title: 2. K4 is Tuesday, sheets print Friday
rect.data-description: ISSUE. Schedules show the wrong day. Fix: default K4 to TEXT(TODAY(),"dddd") with a manual override cell. Section 6.
ISSUE. SEARCH("OBS") matches Lobster. Fix: filter on Gen. Prod. Posting Group <> OBS instead of the description. Sections 1 and 5.
ISSUE. Fix: add X to K (or to the K4-day pounds) before bags are calculated. Section 6.
ISSUE. Non-MCS lines. Fix: drop Fri/Sat from F_Demand for those lines, or from TH_Demand. Section 4.
ISSUE. Julian dates wrong. Fix: Sunday!B1 = 'Daily Supply & Demand'!H2. Section 3.
ISSUE. Text dates in row 284, and grids 1_ and 2_ copy grid 0_. Fix: real dates from H2, and point each grid at its own columns. Section 4.
ISSUE. As of 03/24/26. Fix: re-export Quantity Explosion of BOM. Section 2.

rect.data-title: 9. Two copies of the run list
rect.data-description: ISSUE. Schedules read Critical Lookup Information, not Unique Dough. Fix: point the N:S and D4 lookups at UniqueDough and retire D:O. Sections 1 and 7.
ISSUE. All inventory and Dist demand come from one linked SharePoint file. Fix: keep the link path fixed and tab names consistent, or bring the count into this workbook. Section 3.
ISSUE. Refilling DSD_DSnD columns brings back old logic; 15 columns have no stored formula. Fix: re-enter each column formula across the whole column. Section 4.
ISSUE. Dough D10004, D10061; DSD row 264; Mix-Slice-Oven BK1. Fix: restore the formulas. Sections 1, 4, 6.
ISSUE. Fix: a running sum of minutes from E4 in the schedule spill. Section 7.
ISSUE. 7 blank Optimal Times, 3 LB. Braided = dne, 5 unknown run names, stray spaces. Fix: clean Unique Dough and Products. Section 1.

rect.data-title: 15. Row lists and tables out of step
rect.data-description: ISSUE. DoughWeight drops F2562; other tables carry #N/A rows. Fix: resize each table to its spill. Section 8.
